name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
spiritual_teacher: Sufi dervish tekkes (Blagaj — famous mystical tekke by the Buna spring; 'Bosnian pyramids' in Visoko)
work_strategy: Remote (Flat 10% personal income tax; Double Taxation Treaty with Ukraine)
it_market: Weak (Small cluster of IT companies in Sarajevo and Banja Luka)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0; then 10.88% (AMS-1035: €65–109/mo, Single Tax not credited), but legalization >3–6 months without a local company is blocked.
climate: Temperate (Continental: hot summer, cool snowy winter in the mountains)
nature: Mountains, rivers, forests (Stunning Kravice waterfalls, emerald Neretva, forested Dinaric Alps; symbolic sea access at Neum)
english_level: Difficult (English mostly among students in the capital; Slavic language is somewhat intelligible)
housing_rent: Cheapest in Europe (~€200–260 for a 1-bedroom apartment in Banja Luka or Sarajevo outskirts)

numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

mortgage_expats: Unavailable (Banking system does not lend to non-residents)

items: [Olx.ba](https://olx.ba/kategorija/nekretnine/iznajmljivanje-stanova/23) — #1 portal in Bosnia for everything, including direct owner rentals.

notes: **Strict conditions:** income `€600 / €750 / €800 / €1,000/mo` net after UA FOP Group 3; without opening a local company (*Obrt/Preduzetnik*); >1 year horizon.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_183d: **Critical blocker** — no TP for Ukrainians and no Digital Nomad visa; visa-free stay limited (30/60 or 90/180). Staying >1 year without a local job contract, business, or study is impossible.
fbih_taxes_ams1035: **4% health contribution** on 80% base (= `3.2%` of gross) + **10% PIT** on remaining `76.8%` (= `7.68%` of gross).
**Total effective rate = 10.88% flat** with no minimum threshold! (In Republika Srpska ~10% PIT).
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: Best tax math (`10.88%`), but **unsuitable for >1 year** due to lack of TP and visa-free stay limits.
